ceuadmin/firefox/60.5.1-1.el7  ceuadmin/firefox/147.0.1  ceuadmin/firefox/148.0a1  ceuadmin/firefox/nightly

29/9/2025

--------------------------------------------------- /usr/local/Cluster-Config/modulefiles ---------------------------------------------------
ceuadmin/firefox/60.5.1-1.el7  ceuadmin/firefox/143.0.1  ceuadmin/firefox/143.0a1  ceuadmin/firefox/145.0a1  ceuadmin/firefox/nightly

such that

  • 60.5.1-1.el7 is actually a singularity module.
  • 143.0.1 is the first official release at ceuadmin.
  • 145.0a1 is officially nightly.
  • ceuadmin/firefox/nightly is still a symbolic link to 143.0a1.

The general context is described here, https://cambridge-ceu.github.io/csd3/systems/web.html.

A real-world usage on CSD3 is shown here, https://jinghuazhao.github.io/Caprion/.

entry.title: R 4.6.1 is documented
entry.content:
See < https://cambridge-ceu.github.io/csd3/applications/R.html>

14/07/2026

The current version is 4.6.1.

05/05/2026

The current version is 4.6.0.

16/03/2026

The current version is 4.5.3.

Note that,

  • The series include R/4.5.3-icelake, R/4.5.3-gcc11, R/4.5.3-gcc12.
  • Since R_LIBS has R, R-gcc11/R-gcc12 those in their respective directories are recognised automattically.
  • In the case of R/4.5.3-gcc12, a fully functional gcc/12.5.0 is made, https://cambridge-ceu.github.io/csd3/systems/setup.html#fn:gcc.
    • There might be some residuals from using -lintl, therefore xgboost is experimented with LIBS=”-lintl”.
    • The issue goes away with gcc/12.5.0.
